question: A 36-year-old female presents to clinic inquiring about the meaning of a previous negative test result from a new HIV screening test. The efficacy of this new screening test for HIV has been assessed by comparison against existing gold standard detection of HIV RNA via PCR. The study includes 1000 patients, with 850 HIV-negative patients (by PCR) receiving a negative test result, 30 HIV-negative patients receiving a positive test result, 100 HIV positive patients receiving a positive test result, and 20 HIV positive patients receiving a negative test result. Which of the following is most likely to increase the negative predictive value for this test?

options.opa: Increased prevalence of HIV in the tested population
options.opb: Decreased prevalence of HIV in the tested population
options.opc: Increased number of false positive test results
options.opd: Increased number of false negative test results
options.ope: Decreased number of false positive test results

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Increased prevalence of HIV in the tested population -> higher number of true positive results -> higher true negative results -> increased negative predictive value -> 80% CHAIN: Decreased prevalence of HIV in the tested population -> lower number of true positive results -> lower true negative results -> decreased negative predictive value -> 70% CHAIN: Increased number of false negative test results -> lower true negative results -> decreased negative predictive value -> 60% CHAIN: Increased number of false positive test results -> lower true negative results -> decreased negative predictive value -> 70% CHAIN: Decreased number of false positive test results -> higher true negative results -> increased negative predictive value -> 80%
analysis: In this scenario, to increase the negative predictive value for the test, we need to focus on reducing false negative test results. False negative results can lead to a lower negative predictive value, as they indicate that individuals who actually have the condition are being missed by the test.
